metric_definitions.ne_m: 3D final position distance to the shared reference trajectory endpoint (original metric.py NE)
metric_definitions.final_target_distance_m: 3D final position distance to shared mark.json target
metric_definitions.action_count: (saved_state_count-1)/5, supported by camera indices; directly checked against diffusion trace counts
metric_definitions.initial_orientation_gap_degrees: normalized quaternion geodesic rotation difference; includes roll, pitch and yaw
metric_definitions.sensor_has_collided: saved sensor contact flag, not equivalent to evaluator collision/heuristic termination flag
metric_definitions.saved_state_count: includes five identical position/timestamp copies per post-action sample
metric_definitions.min_sampled_target_distance_m: minimum over saved positions, not the continuous trajectory or official OSR

comparability_limits: Paired historical results, not a controlled rerun; observed initial poses differ.
Historical baseline checkpoint, RNG and runtime are not identified by the result directories alone.
Goal distance uses a common annotated target; no historical per-step target trace is stored.
Raw all-task path/action averages include early failures; use the five jointly successful tasks for paired efficiency analysis.
Original evaluation includes GT-position-derived semantic direction and a 20 m success threshold.
